attempts.text: MATCH (p:Person) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]-(i:Issue) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:LOGGED_TIME]->(j:Issue) RETURN count(DISTINCT p) AS people, count(DISTINCT i) AS a, count(DISTINCT j) AS b

MATCH (p:Person)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]-(i:Issue) WITH i,p RETURN i.issueKey AS k, p.personKey AS pk UNION MATCH (p:Person)-[:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue) RETURN i.issueKey AS k, p.personKey AS pk

MATCH (a:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(b:Person) WHERE l.seconds>0 AND a<>b MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project) WITH collect(DISTINCT a.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT b.personKey) AS ps, collect(DISTINCT pr.projectKey) AS prs UNWIND ps AS x RETURN DISTINCT x AS id, 'person' AS kind UNION MATCH (a:Person)-[l:LOGGED_TIME]->(i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(b:Person) WHERE l.seconds>0 AND a<>b MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project) RETURN DISTINCT pr.projectKey AS id, 'project' AS kind
